title: The Show Grill- For all things BBQ, skewers and grilling!

comparisons.notes: Same product title, new, buyable with Nov 7-11 estimated delivery.

writeup: The Show Grill is a stainless charcoal barrel grill that hangs 22 skewers at once over the coals, with a 34x38cm cooking area. Woot has it new for $42.99, while Tanga sells the same grill for $93.99, about 54% less here. Stock is very limited, with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Spec-identical 22-skewer barrel grill matched by image and spec block.
